spanish: Y hicieron así hijos de Israel, y recogieron el que aumentaba y el que disminuía.
grammarChanges: Restored the missing verbal predicate for the two hiphil active participles (h02016017006 הַמַּרְבֶּה, h02016017007 וְהַמַּמְעִיט): the bare quantity words "mucho" and "poco" had no verb, so they become the finite forms "aumentaba" and "disminuía," keeping the hiphil causative stem force ("the one who caused much" / "the one who caused little") instead of plain adjectives.
readerNote: Chose "aumentaba" and "disminuía" as the finite verbs carrying the hiphil causative force of the two participles, since the draft had left them as bare quantity words with no predicate.
